description: Analyst recommendation trends for one US symbol: strong-buy / buy / hold / sell / strong-sell counts per month, newest first. The consensus view to pair with the live quote and fundamentals from finnhub_get_company. Resolve a company name with finnhub_search_symbols first.

limit.description: Max months to return, newest first. Default 12 (one year of consensus history). The API typically returns 12–24 months; setting this higher surfaces older trend data.

symbol.description: US stock ticker (e.g., "AAPL"). Resolve a name with finnhub_search_symbols first.

name: finnhub_get_recommendations

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_coverage`: Endpoint returned an empty array — no analyst coverage for the symbol. `not_us_or_paid`: Upstream HTTP 403 — international or paid-only symbol. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

totalCount.description: Total months available before the limit.

trends.description: Recommendation counts per month, newest first. Typically 12–24 months of history.

items.description: One month of analyst recommendation counts.

buy.description: Number of analysts with a Buy rating this month.

hold.description: Number of analysts with a Hold rating this month.

period.description: Month the consensus is for (YYYY-MM-DD, first of month).

sell.description: Number of analysts with a Sell rating this month.

strongBuy.description: Number of analysts with a Strong Buy rating this month.

strongSell.description: Number of analysts with a Strong Sell rating this month.

truncated.description: True when months were capped at the limit.

title: Finnhub Get Recommendations
